* AgentBiz quant-research SPSS syntax.
* Demonstration/specification only. This file does not contain estimated results.
* Do not treat this as executed output from SPSS.

VARIABLE LABELS
  PU1 'Using this system would improve my performance.'
  PU2 'Using this system would increase my productivity.'
  PU3 'Using this system would make it harder to do my job.'
  PEU1 'Learning to use this system would be easy for me.'
  PEU2 'I would find this system easy to use.'
  PEU3 'This system would be cumbersome to operate.'
  BI1 'I intend to use this system.'
  BI2 'I predict I would use this system.'
  BI3 'I would not hesitate to use this system.'
  .

VALUE LABELS PU1 PU2 PU3 PEU1 PEU2 PEU3 BI1 BI2 BI3
  1 'Strongly disagree'
  3 'Neutral'
  5 'Strongly agree'
  .

RECODE PU3 (1=5) (2=4) (3=3) (4=2) (5=1) INTO PU3_R.
VARIABLE LABELS PU3_R 'Using this system would make it harder to do my job. (reversed)'.
RECODE PEU3 (1=5) (2=4) (3=3) (4=2) (5=1) INTO PEU3_R.
VARIABLE LABELS PEU3_R 'This system would be cumbersome to operate. (reversed)'.

RELIABILITY
  /VARIABLES=PU1 PU2 PU3_R
  /MODEL=ALPHA
  /SUMMARY=TOTAL.

RELIABILITY
  /VARIABLES=PEU1 PEU2 PEU3_R
  /MODEL=ALPHA
  /SUMMARY=TOTAL.

RELIABILITY
  /VARIABLES=BI1 BI2 BI3
  /MODEL=ALPHA
  /SUMMARY=TOTAL.

* Structural / SEM estimation is out of scope for this compiler.
* Use AMOS, lavaan, or SmartPLS emitters for path specifications.
